errors.released_in_unlisted: lock: {migration} released in {release}, which is not a listed release
errors.not_release_version: {version:%q} is not a release version (want 1.2.3 or 1.2.3-rc.1)
errors.release_already_listed: release {release} is already in the lock

lint.no_contract: destructive without a Contract: split it (docs/migrations.md) or add Contract{StoppedUsingIn, Reason}
lint.contract_release_not_cut: Contract.StoppedUsingIn {release:%q} is not a cut release in the lock

problems.not_in_lock: {migration} is not in the lock: run `make migrations-lock`
problems.shipped_sql_changed: {migration} shipped in {release} and its SQL changed. A published migration never changes: add a new migration instead
problems.changed_since_lock: {migration} changed since the lock was written: run `make migrations-lock`
problems.contract_reason_empty: {migration}: Contract.Reason is empty: say what goes and why
problems.shipped_gone: {migration} shipped in {release} and is gone from the code. A published migration never goes away
problems.lock_only: {migration} is in the lock but not in the code: run `make migrations-lock`
problems.release_removed: release {release} was removed from the lock
problems.shipped_removed_from_lock: {migration} shipped in {release} and was removed from the lock
problems.shipped_hash_changed: {migration} shipped in {release} and its hash changed in the lock
problems.shipped_release_changed: {migration} shipped in {release}; the lock now says {now:%q}
problems.release_not_newer_than_base: release {release} added, but the base already has {latest}
problems.relock_sql_changed: {migration} shipped in {release} and its SQL changed; revert it and add a new migration
problems.relock_gone: {migration} shipped in {release} and is gone from the code; restore it
problems.release_not_listed: the lock does not list release {release}: run `make migrations-release VERSION={release}` in the release PR
